create.name: Mark Guay
create.bio:
Mark Guay is a San Diego coach and meditation teacher whose work joins leadership development with inner, archetypal and energetic practice. An adoptee who grew up with violence at home, he speaks openly about how family history is carried in the body and how facing it can change what is handed on. He holds a master's degree in education, qualified as an Integral Coach through Integral Coaching Canada, and has trained in Internal Family Systems with mentors including Robert Falconer and Cece Sykes. He describes himself as a lightworker and has coached senior people in finance and technology for more than fifteen years.

Most of his clients are founders, executives and fathers in mid-life who feel that their old idea of success has run its course; his Second Mountain programme helps them name their values, shape a five-year vision and work with the inner parts that resist change. His recorded courses take a more contemplative route: one moves through the seven chakras towards a short daily manifestation ritual, another uses masculine archetypes as a rite of passage into fatherhood. On Insight Timer he shares guided meditations, breathwork and versions of these course journeys.

courses.title: Climbing Your Second Mountain: Design Your Vision And Awaken Your Soul Purpose
courses.description: A seventeen-day Insight Timer course for people who sense a new chapter ahead. It works through core values and a five-year vision, then turns to the habits of self-sabotage that block it.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Manifest Your Unlimited Potential
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course that rises through the chakras one guided meditation at a time, from root to crown. It ends with a five-minute daily ritual that treats manifestation as aligned, practical action.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Awaken The Father King
courses.description: A self-paced course for fathers who also lead businesses, drawing on depth psychology and four masculine archetypes: king, elder, warrior and builder. Reflective exercises lead into a short daily ritual and close on the theme of legacy.

courses.title: Second Mountain Coaching
courses.description: A one-to-one programme for senior leaders that opens with Hogan assessments and a values-based five-year vision, followed by fifteen sessions using parts work. Messaging support between calls and an optional one-day private immersion are part of the offer.
courses.price: Contact for pricing (optional Breakthrough Immersion $10k USD)

free_resources.title: Mark Guay on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations, breathwork and reflective practices on purpose, leadership, fatherhood and the chakras. The single tracks are free to hear.

free_resources.title: Seven Dimensional Breathing
free_resources.description: A free guided breathing practice of under five minutes with a short integration guide, sent by email. It is designed as a quick way to settle and become present before demanding moments.

flags: He is mainly an executive and leadership coach for founders and fathers; the spiritual side (chakra and manifestation course, archetypal men's work, 'lightworker', Insight Timer meditations) is real but secondary, so a human may want to check the fit.

Email mark@markwguay.me appears in the site's store policy text embedded on every page ("please send me an email at mark@markwguay.me"), not as a visible contact line; the contact page also has a form.
No videos: his YouTube channel @markwguay has no public uploads; interviews on other channels were not added.
Prices for his own Squarespace courses are not shown publicly (shown only after login); set to Contact for pricing.
His about page mentions childhood domestic violence and generational healing; the bio mentions his background but no treatment claims.
Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch; bio check relied mainly on his own site pages.
